mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_PAGE_LOG ( SESSION_ID, MEMBER_NO, REQUEST_URL, REQUEST_METHOD, HTTP_STATUS, REQUEST_IP, USER_AGENT, REFERER, DURATION_MS ) VALUES ( #{dto.session_id}, #{dto.member_no, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.request_url}, #{dto.request_method, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.http_status, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.request_ip, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.user_agent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.referer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.duration_ms, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select:
SELECT LOG_NO, SESSION_ID, MEMBER_NO, REQUEST_URL, REQUEST_METHOD, HTTP_STATUS, REQUEST_IP, USER_AGENT, REFERER, DURATION_MS, ACCESSED_AT FROM MEMBER_PAGE_LOG
ORDER BY LOG_NO DESC
OFFSET #{dto.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{dto.size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT LOG_NO, SESSION_ID, MEMBER_NO, REQUEST_URL, REQUEST_METHOD, HTTP_STATUS, REFERER, ACCESSED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ACCESSED_AT, LOG_NO) AS STEP_NO, ROUND( ( CAST(LEAD(ACCESSED_AT) OVER (ORDER BY ACCESSED_AT, LOG_NO) AS DATE) - CAST(ACCESSED_AT AS DATE) ) * 86400 ) AS DWELL_SEC FROM MEMBER_PAGE_LOG WHERE SESSION_ID = #{session_id} ORDER BY ACCESSED_AT, LOG_NO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_view, COUNT(DISTINCT SESSION_ID) AS total_session, COUNT(DISTINCT MEMBER_NO) AS member_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT SESSION_ID), 0), 1) AS avg_pages_per_session FROM MEMBER_PAGE_LOG

WITH page_dwell AS ( SELECT REQUEST_URL, SESSION_ID, ROUND( ( CAST(LEAD(ACCESSED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY SESSION_ID ORDER BY ACCESSED_AT, LOG_NO) AS DATE) - CAST(ACCESSED_AT AS DATE) ) * 86400 ) AS DWELL_SEC FROM MEMBER_PAGE_LOG
) SELECT REQUEST_URL AS request_url, COUNT(*) AS view_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT SESSION_ID) AS session_cnt, ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN DWELL_SEC BETWEEN 0 AND 1800 THEN DWELL_SEC END), 1) AS avg_dwell_sec, ROUND(MEDIAN(CASE WHEN DWELL_SEC BETWEEN 0 AND 1800 THEN DWELL_SEC END), 1) AS median_dwell_sec FROM page_dwell GROUP BY REQUEST_URL ORDER BY view_cnt DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(ACCESSED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS view_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT SESSION_ID) AS session_cnt FROM MEMBER_PAGE_LOG
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(ACCESSED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY stat_date

WITH t AS ( SELECT SESSION_ID, REQUEST_URL AS FROM_URL, LEAD(REQUEST_URL) OVER (PARTITION BY SESSION_ID ORDER BY ACCESSED_AT, LOG_NO) AS TO_URL FROM MEMBER_PAGE_LOG
) SELECT FROM_URL AS from_url, TO_URL AS to_url, COUNT(*) AS transition_cnt FROM t WHERE TO_URL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FROM_URL, TO_URL ORDER BY transition_cnt DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
